title: FleetReport
description: Aggregated health + drift view across the fleet registry, produced by bin/fleet-doctor.sh. `repos[]` is sorted worst-first (unscored error/missing rows first, then ascending score). In live mode each row carries the repo's doctor exit code and drift counters; in cached mode rows are read from each repo's persisted memory/health.json without invoking doctor, and staleness is flagged instead. With --drift (live only), each drifted row embeds the repo's full doctor JSON under drift_report. Self-contained by design: this shape is the integration point for future exporters.

score.description: Health score — computed live, or the last persisted entry in cached mode. Null when unavailable (error / no history).

direction.description: Trend direction from the repo's persisted health history (null when no history).

drift.description: Drift counters from the live doctor run (null in cached mode / on error).

worst_category.description: Health-score breakdown category with the largest deduction (null when the score is clean or unavailable).

profile_source.description: pin = fleet-entry override; repo = the repo's own hint (.nyann/profile or CLAUDE.md); fallback = audited against `default` because nothing resolved.

health_age_days.description: Age of the newest persisted health entry (null when no history).

status.description: ok = audited/read cleanly; stale = cached entry older than --stale-days; missing = cached mode with no health history; error = repo path dead, doctor failed, or timed out.

exit_code.description: The repo's drift severity in live mode, derived from the doctor JSON with doctor's text-mode exit rules (0 clean / 4 warn / 5 critical; the probe-escalated doctor rc is folded in as a floor). Null in cached mode or on error.

drift_report.description: Full doctor --json output for the repo. Present only with --drift (live mode) on drifted rows.
